Discourage 'standard' in EIP titles & descriptions (closes #5009) (#5026)

Remove mention of rationale containing "proof of consensus". (#4951)

We have a pretty strict policy that EIPs are purely technical standards and *NOT* the place to establish (or prove) consensus.  There are many EIPs that have not achieved consensus and they are perfectly valid technical standards, even though they are not implemented in Ethereum today.

Update to canonical eip-X format (#2734)

It appears that the format `EIP-X` is preferred to `EIPX`:

```console
$ grep "EIP-[0-9]+" * | wc -l
373

$ grep "EIP[0-9]+" * | wc -l
118
```

Also note that several of the `EIPX` references are coming from `index.html` and `EIPS/eip-1.md`.

```console
$ grep "EIP[0-9]+" index.html | wc -l
4

$ grep "EIP[0-9]+" EIPS/eip-1.md | wc -l
13
```

I have updated `index.html` and `eip-1` accordingly.
